Selling, General and Administrative Expenses have also increased, but not dramatically. Depreciation and Amortization have increased, this is expected due to potential asset growth.

**Overall Sentiment:**

The positive top-line growth and improved operating income are counterbalanced by the sharp decrease in net income and concern for cash.
